A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' served as a staffer for [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Her [[Unidentified Coruscant Security officer (Organa staffer's sister)|sister]] worked as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].
